name: Summon Warhound
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level sorcerer/wizard 8, summoner 6, witch 7

CASTING

Casting Time one round
Components V, S, F (DF)

EFFECT

Range close (25 feet + 5 ft./ 2 caster levels)
Effect Summons a Unique Nessian warhound (CR 11)
Duration one round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell summons a unique Nessian warhound. Treat it as a Nessian warhound with the following exceptions: It is immune to fire, cold, and acid, and it is immune to all spells 3rd level and below. Black Gnash devours the soul of any creature it kills; they cannot be raised, resurrected, or reincarnated. Wish or miracle is required.
